body.heading: A Rainy Day
paragraphs: I look out of the window. It is raining. Gray clouds fill the sky.
I put on my yellow raincoat. I hold my blue umbrella up high.
Splish, splash! I jump in the puddles. The rain feels cool on my nose. I love to play in the rain.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. What do YOU like to wear on a rainy day? What color is your umbrella — or the one you wish you had?
2. What sounds does rain make? Can you make three rain sounds with your hands and voice?

takeaway: Every answer hides in the story's sentences — the weather, the colors, and where the child jumps.
materials: Just you and this page — no materials needed
supervision: A grown-up nearby is recommended for younger readers; the think-and-talk questions work well read aloud together.
safetyNotes: Reading only — no physical activity or materials are involved.
screenFreeExtension: After reading, close the screen and retell three things you learned to someone at home in your own words.
